title: Shared folders
lede: Folders this computer shares with your other computers, and folders they share with it.
ledeAll: Folders your computers share with each other.
scope.label: Show shares of
given.title: This computer shares
received.title: Shared with this computer
all.title: Every shared folder
given.emptyBody: This computer shares none of its folders.
received.emptyBody: None of your other computers shares a folder with this one.
all.emptyBody: None of your computers shares a folder.
dropped_one: {{count}} shared folder could not be read and is not shown.
dropped_other: {{count}} shared folders could not be read and are not shown.
line.sending: The Hub is sending a change to this share.
line.unsure: The answer to a change was lost. The Hub is checking what happened.
line.expired: Its end has passed. The server is removing it.
line.legacy: {{to}} doesn't show it: it was made by an older version. Share the folder again to use it.
line.unreadable: The server gave a state this Hub doesn't know.
line.failed: The server couldn't set it up.
line.waiting: The server is still setting it up. This list checks again every few seconds.
line.pausedRw: {{to}} can read it but can't write to it for now.
line.interrupted: It isn't reaching {{to}} at the moment.
line.unclear: The server didn't say where it appears or when it ends, so the Hub can't tell whether it works.
line.on: Hoody set this up. It can take a minute to appear on {{to}}.
line.lost: Recent changes made on {{to}} may have been lost.
act.wait: Check the earlier change to this list first.
act.notHere: This share's computer isn't listed here, so the Hub can't change it from this list.
new.title: Share a folder
new.subtitle: From {{name}} to another of your computers
new.rwWarn: {{to}} can change and delete the files in this folder on {{from}}.
new.rwWarnNoTarget: The other computer can change and delete the files in this folder on {{from}}.
new.at: It appears on the other computer under /hoody/shares. The list shows the exact folder once it is shared.
new.pendingDetail: Check whether the folder was shared.
new.unread: Couldn't read what {{name}} already shares, so nothing was sent. Try again.
why.chars: Sharing takes only English letters, digits and / - _ . ( ) in a folder's path. Rename the folder to share it.
why.long: This path is too long to share.
why.dots: A path with . or .. parts can't be shared.
why.root: The top folder and /hoody can't be shared. Choose a folder inside.
why.received: This folder comes from another computer. Share it from its own computer.
why.connected: This folder is connected storage or a folder from your PC. Share a folder that is on this computer.
why.target: Choose the computer to share with.
why.exists: This folder is already shared with {{to}}.
err.limit: This server already has as many shared folders as it can take. Stop sharing one first.
err.collision: A shared folder with this name already exists too many times. Rename the folder, then share it again.
err.self: A computer can't share a folder with itself.
err.owner: Only the owner of both computers can share their folders.
err.path: The server didn't accept this share. Check the folder path and the computer.
held.create: Sharing {{path}} with {{to}} may have gone through.
held.setEnabled.on: Turning on the share of {{path}} may have gone through.
held.setEnabled.off: Turning off the share of {{path}} may have gone through.
held.setMode: Changing the access to {{path}} may have gone through.
held.retry: Trying the share of {{path}} again may have gone through.
held.stop: Stopping the share of {{path}} may have gone through.
off.title: Turn off this share?
off.body: {{to}} stops seeing {{path}} until you turn it on again. A program on {{to}} using it may be restarted.
rw.title: Let {{to}} write to this folder?
rw.body: {{to}} will be able to change and delete the files in {{path}} on {{from}}.
ro.title: Make this share read only?
ro.body: {{to}} keeps reading {{path}} but can no longer change it. A program on {{to}} writing there may be restarted.
stop.title: Stop sharing {{path}}?
stop.body: {{to}} loses the folder. The files stay on {{from}}.
stop.bodyRw: {{to}} loses the folder. The files stay on {{from}}, with the changes {{to}} made. A program on {{to}} using them may be restarted.
new.folderHelp: A folder on {{name}}, from its top folder.
